invariant: Every production interaction must close UI source to typed command or event, canonical owner, validation, durable state, receipt, projection, and recovery. The prototype reducer is deterministic evidence only.

flows.payload_and_idempotency: thread_id, project_id?, message_id, content_ref, attachment_refs, model_request_ref?, idempotency_key
flows.validation: projection current, route available, attachment resolution accepted, Permissions/FileSafe and size limits
flows.durable_state: message, assistant turn/run, outbox envelope when offline
flows.projection: transcript, composer, active work, Usage, diagnostics
flows.cancel_retry_restore: stop, active-turn redirect, retry, reconnect/replay, snapshot catch-up

flows.validation: active run identity and current projection
flows.durable_state: stopped episode and retained partial evidence
flows.projection: composer returns to Send; work summary becomes stopped/resumable
flows.cancel_retry_restore: resume or fresh attempt only when owner allows

flows.ui_source: Offline Send, Reconnect, Replay queued commands, Snapshot catch-up
flows.command_or_event: canonical command envelope plus environment connection events
flows.owner: Project Home Server, outbox, environment connection supervision
flows.payload_and_idempotency: stable operation_id, client cursor, snapshot cursor, authenticated client and thread identity
flows.validation: dedupe by operation identity; cursor monotonicity; target thread remains valid
flows.durable_state: outbox item, replay result, delivered message, cursor checkpoint
flows.receipt: queued, reconnecting, replayed once or zero-op replay, snapshot applied
flows.projection: transport, domain, continuing server work, per-item delivery state
flows.cancel_retry_restore: retained queue, retry reconnect, replay, fetch snapshot; never duplicate send

flows.ui_source: Search bar scope, result, and exact jump
flows.owner: Chat history search and Thread Service
flows.payload_and_idempotency: scope, query, thread_id, message_id, result cursor, projection revision
flows.validation: message remains visible under retention/permissions; unloaded range is fetchable
flows.durable_state: no transcript mutation; optional thread-local search/view state
flows.receipt: exact range loaded and target focus restored
flows.projection: one-bar current/all results, highlighted excerpt, selected message
flows.cancel_retry_restore: clear query, change scope, retry range fetch, return to latest anchor

flows.ui_source: Context Ring, message Context action, mode buttons, Subcompact, Compact Now
flows.payload_and_idempotency: thread/message ids, mode, selected range, source refs, expected context revision, idempotency key for material compaction
flows.validation: eligible canonical refs, explicit Subcompact confirmation, context budget, no secret/raw prompt disclosure
flows.durable_state: admission receipt, summary artifact and rehydration refs; view selection as scoped state
flows.receipt: included/omitted sources, compact status, source and cache provenance
flows.projection: Ring percent, Lens modes, memory/cache detail, message selection
flows.cancel_retry_restore: turn off, clear, revert Subcompact, retry failed compaction

flows.ui_source: Question answer, Back, Next, Skip, Cancel questionnaire, Submit
flows.command_or_event: candidate cmd.chat.question.* mapped to the live question tool owner
flows.owner: shared question flow and requesting parent runtime
flows.payload_and_idempotency: questionnaire_id, question_id, queue index, answer value/ref, explicit skip, expected revision, idempotency key on submit
flows.validation: required answer or explicit skip, input type, parent/child ownership, queue revision
flows.durable_state: ordered queue, draft answers, skips, cancellation record, immutable submission receipt
flows.projection: eight concept-specific question grammars over one lifecycle
flows.cancel_retry_restore: cancel restores ordinary draft; reopen retains answers; failed submit remains reviewable

flows.command_or_event: cmd.chat.goal.start/update plus adjudicated Goal Runtime actions
flows.payload_and_idempotency: thread_id, goal_id/revision, objective/update, action, checkpoint/evidence refs, reason, idempotency key
flows.validation: current Goal revision, allowed transition, evidence and blocker authority
flows.durable_state: objective, phase, tasks, cursor, checkpoint, children, evidence, replan/terminal record
flows.projection: Goal, Todo, progress, blocked evidence, completion report in every thread grammar
flows.cancel_retry_restore: pause/resume, replan, recover, stop, clear projection without erasing canonical record

flows.ui_source: Subagent, Crew, request, await, spawn, and handoff controls
flows.command_or_event: candidate thread-request/spawn wrappers plus Orchestrator actions
flows.payload_and_idempotency: parent/source/target thread, Plan/Goal ids, bounded passage refs, role, provider/account/model route, worktree, permits, operation key
flows.validation: admission, capacity, permissions, route, worktree and provider permits, nesting ceiling
flows.durable_state: child identity, queue/wave, state, parent link, attributable result and synthesis receipt
flows.projection: distinct child rows, relay zones, strands, staves, and parent synthesis
flows.cancel_retry_restore: cancel/retry/fallback/resume while preserving failed handoff and partial evidence

flows.command_or_event: cmd.account.select_profile, cmd.provider.switch_route, cmd.chat.model, cmd.chat.effort, cmd.chat.mode, cmd.chat.platform, speed candidate
flows.owner: Models, Multi-Account, provider routing, and Settings
flows.validation: authentication, entitlement, availability, policy, capability, host/environment, allowance
flows.durable_state: requested and effective route snapshots; favorite/default in Settings only when persistent
flows.receipt: route selected or disabled reason; cache/context/tool/attachment re-evaluation
flows.projection: compact current route, requested/effective difference, material warning, setup deep link
flows.cancel_retry_restore: cancel change, branch with new route, retry setup/refresh, verified rollback in shared manager

flows.payload_and_idempotency: thread id, requested value, expected policy revision, requested scope, idempotency key when persistent
flows.validation: mode ceiling, policy, protected effect, scope confirmation
flows.durable_state: thread-local request/effective snapshot; project/global default only in Settings
flows.projection: exact human labels and compact state
flows.cancel_retry_restore: revert current thread value, retry unavailable review, open Settings for broader scope

flows.ui_source: Approval and material route warning cards
flows.command_or_event: cmd.runtime.approve / cmd.runtime.decline and provider route branch/cancel action
flows.owner: runtime approval, Permissions, FileSafe, provider routing
flows.payload_and_idempotency: blocked episode and attempt identity, policy snapshot, route delta, privacy/cache/cost evidence, operation key
flows.validation: decision still current, actor authorized, exact effect scope, no approval laundering
flows.receipt: approved once, declined, continued, branched, cancelled, stale decision
flows.projection: compact inline card plus canonical title-bar notification for app-wide outcome
flows.cancel_retry_restore: reopen detail, request again, choose safer branch, no silent destructive action

flows.ui_source: Artifact shortcut, tabs, retry, close, Open in editor, Reveal file
flows.command_or_event: Artifact Service and editor/file route commands after exact catalog resolution
flows.owner: Artifact Service, editor, and File Manager
flows.payload_and_idempotency: artifact id, version, source thread/message, lineage, path/redaction, editor target, operation id
flows.validation: identity/version current, retained, permitted, redacted, target available
flows.durable_state: artifact record and selected workspace identity
flows.projection: left workspace, source shortcut, version and owner actions
flows.cancel_retry_restore: retry, close/reopen preserving selection, choose prior version; prototype route actions remain disabled

flows.ui_source: Branch, rewind, create restore point, redirect
flows.command_or_event: cmd.chat.rewind, cmd.chat.create_restore_point, cmd.chat.branch_from_restore, candidate ordinary branch/redirect
flows.payload_and_idempotency: project/thread/source message, branch or restore identity/hash, current revision, new title?, idempotency key
flows.validation: source retained/current, immutable hash, permissions, in-flight/hold and lineage rules
flows.durable_state: conversation branch tree and restore_point_record; no workspace mutation
flows.receipt: rewound, restore created, branched/refused/failed, redirected with prior attempt retained
flows.projection: ancestry fold, source link, sibling branch, current state
flows.cancel_retry_restore: cancel before commit, retry exact refused action when evidence changes; no fake file rollback

flows.payload_and_idempotency: panel id, current host, target window/host, expected layout revision, operation id
flows.durable_state: layout/window identity only; Chat semantic state retains stable ids
flows.projection: same history, artifact, draft, scroll anchor, popup and selected thread after remount
flows.cancel_retry_restore: retry stale layout or restore prior host

closure_gaps: Exact production IDs for all-thread search scope, question lifecycle, Goal transitions beyond start/update, speed, access, BSD, artifact actions, attachment resolution, draft restore/clear, and thread request/await/spawn require catalog adjudication.
The prototype cannot prove production handler reverse coverage or EventRecord registration because Commands/Wiring/runtime were read-only by task boundary.
The exact notification-inbox navigation row must be resolved in the shared title-bar owner before integration.
